_comment: Figures for the Rasuwa-Bhotekoshi flood, from NDRRMA / Ministry of Home Affairs, 14 Bhadra 13:00. Compiled from that government statement as published on the Rasuwa flood bulletin (nirajbhusal.github.io/rasuwa-flood-bulletin) — the bulletin is someone else's aggregation; the government statement is the source. These are reviewed content and are served exactly as written - there is no longer a live scrape laying newer figures over them, so a stale number here is a stale number on the page. The overview also shows live government figures beside this grid (BIPAD corridor incidents, NDRRMA rescued-persons totals, OPMCM portal counters); those come straight from the portals and are never merged into these numbers. Two rules govern edits. (1) Never sum across groups that the source keeps apart - the `exclusive` flags and `do_not_merge` notes exist because several of these counts overlap, and adding them would invent casualties. (2) Every breakdown must sum to its own stated total; lib/flood.ts re-adds them at load and the page shows a warning if either stops reconciling.

breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The public missing-report forms, Hello Sarkar (140), Madhesh Police (30) and the tourist list (668) are separate collections. The same person can appear in more than one. Do not add this breakdown on top of 2,502. Police 25 are already inside the official 2,502.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: सार्वजनिक हराएको फारम, हेलो सरकार (१४०), मधेश प्रहरी (३०) र पर्यटक सूची (६६८) छुट्टै संकलन हुन्। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ। यो विभाजन २,५०२ माथि नजोड्नुहोस्। प्रहरी २५ आधिकारिक २,५०२ भित्र छन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: Police, 13 Bhadra 07:00. A label, not a substitute for the official injured figure of 239.

breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Kathmandu valley hospitals and Rasuwa Hospital Dhunche describe the same injured people at a different point in their care — they are not added to the 239 or to this police total.

notes.body_en: 26 staff across 8 banks. Branches were washed away at Timure, Syaphrubesi and Betrawati.

notes.body_en: About 1,000 inmates are safe. The building at Bidur-3 is damaged.

name_lists.do_not_merge_en: Eight lists, published separately by different offices. The same person can appear on more than one, so they are never added into a single rescue total. The official injured figure stays 239. NDRRMA's graphic of 8,730 rescued is a separate count from these named lists.
name_lists.do_not_merge_ne: आठ सूची, फरक-फरक कार्यालयले छुट्टै प्रकाशित गरेका। एउटै व्यक्ति एकभन्दा बढी सूचीमा पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यी एउटै उद्धार जम्मामा जोडिँदैनन्। आधिकारिक घाइते संख्या २३९ नै रहन्छ। एनडीआरआरएमएको उद्धार ग्राफिक ८,७३० यी नामावलीभन्दा छुट्टै गणना हो।
